card.name: The start of hyper- lab terms
card.fires_on: The word piece "hyper" (or "Hyper") that begins a lab-abnormality term such as hyperkalemia, hyperglycemia, hypercalcemia or hyperuricemia. It appears in warnings about drugs raising blood levels.

modes.label: Hyper before electrolyte
modes.description: "hyper" opens an electrolyte term like hyperkalemia or hypercalcemia after a verb such as cause.

card.writes: It likely pushes the model toward finishing the word with a specific ending, rather than words about deficits or shortages.
card.plain: It lights up on the opening "hyper" of words like hyperkalemia, where blood levels of something are too high.
